job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Senior Developer will design and implement logical, functional software code across multiple programming languages, make informed technology choices for different environments, rapidly diagnose and correct complex software issues in mission-critical systems, and help design, integrate, and optimize natural language processing (NLP) capabilities in support of operational missions
What You'll Be DoingAdvanced Software Design & Development
Create logical and functional software code in a variety of programming languages to support Drone Armor capabilities
Lead the design and implementation of software components, services, and interfaces based on system and mission requirements
Ensure solutions are robust, secure, maintainable, and aligned with program architecture and coding standards
Design and implement services and pipelines that incorporate NLP models and text processing components into C-UAS workflows (e.g., analysis of communications, reports, or operator inputs)
Collaborate with data scientists and ML/NLP engineers to integrate NLP models into production systems
Implement and optimize NLP pipelines for tasks such as classification, entity extraction, summarization, translation, or intent detection, as required by mission needs
Integrate large language models and other NLP components via APIs or model-serving infrastructure, ensuring performance, reliability, and security
Work with stakeholders to translate mission and operational requirements into concrete NLP features and user-facing capabilities
Understand and articulate the benefits and risks associated with different coding languages and frameworks in various functional environments
Provide technical guidance to developers on language and framework selection, coding practices, architectural decisions, and NLP integration strategies
Troubleshooting, Debugging & Quality
React to software problems quickly and effectively, correcting code and related configurations as necessary
Debug complex issues across multiple layers (application, service, interface, data) and environments (development, integration, field)
Diagnose and resolve issues specific to NLP-enabled features, including latency, accuracy, unexpected outputs, and integration failures

Support and refine unit, integration, and system-level tests, including tests for NLP components (e.g., input validation, model behavior checks, regression tests on text datasets) to validate functionality and prevent regressions
Leadership & Collaboration
Serve as a senior technical resource within the development team, mentoring junior and mid-level developers
Coach team members on best practices for integrating NLP capabilities into existing architectures and workflows
Collaborate with systems engineers, test engineers, data scientists, NLP/ML engineers, and field personnel to resolve issues and improve system performance
Contribute to technical reviews, design walkthroughs, and continuous improvement of development and AI/NLP integration practices

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will build and deploy production machine learning and large language model (LLM) systems that extract actionable insights from complex legal documents and data. You will work on challenging natural language processing problems involving contractual language, information extraction, model-driven analysis, and comparisons across large collections of documents.

You will join a highly technical machine learning team and collaborate with machine learning engineers, legal subject matter experts, product engineers, and data and security partners. This is a hands-on role for someone who has personally built, trained, evaluated, and deployed machine learning models into production and wants to apply that expertise to sophisticated real-world products.

jobs_results.job_title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer (Natural Language Systems)
jobs_results.description:
## Senior Full Stack AI Engineer (Natural Language Systems)

Prompt is a mission-driven startup transforming healthcare through innovative B2B enterprise software for rehab therapy businesses. We're looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to lead our ambitious AI initiatives, with particular emphasis on speech and language processing. You'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of real-world AI applications in healthcare—building systems that are used every day by clinics, staff, and patients.

We've established ourselves as the go-to platform in the rehab therapy space and are rapidly growing our market share by delivering software people love. As we scale our telephony AI and speech processing initiatives—including our AI scribe and other real-time language workflows—we need an innovative engineer who loves solving high-impact problems. This role combines deep technical expertise in AI with strong software engineering fundamentals to build reliable, production-grade systems that apply the latest generative AI and ML methods to real-world workflows where speed, accuracy, and results matter.

### What You'll Do

You'll drive Prompt's mission to improve healthcare through modern technology and lead AI projects from ideation through architecture to production and iteration until features are widely adopted and loved. This means developing and deploying real-time AI systems involving speech and natural language understanding—think transcription, summarization, and classification at scale. You'll build robust model and prompt pipelines for LLM-powered workflows with high accuracy and monitoring standards that matter.

Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, you'll identify high-leverage AI opportunities and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll help develop Prompt's strategic AI roadmap across speech, NLP, and core automation workflows, applying AI to improve client and internal operations including clinical documentation, customer support, and billing workflows. A critical part of this role involves developing a deep understanding of Prompt's product, customers, and the business of rehab therapy itself.

Beyond individual contributions, you'll help grow and lead the AI team, including training and development of junior team members.

### What We're Looking For

You need at least 4+ years of experience building AI/ML systems in industry or academia with meaningful production ownership. Strong experience building and evaluating NLP and/or LLM systems is essential—this includes retrieval, summarization, classification, extraction, and agent workflows. You must have real experience working with speech-related pipelines in production or near-real-time settings, such as speech-to-text, spoken intent classification, or conversational AI.

A track record of benchmarking and iteratively improving accuracy, cost, and latency is important. You should have an enthusiastic and pragmatic problem-solving mindset, along with excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Technically, you'll need Python (>3.9), Docker basics, and AWS familiarity (S3, RDS, EC2) is preferred. You should be willing to learn and deeply understand the healthcare sector, specifically physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy.

This is a heavy code contribution role—please only apply if you're interested in that; this is not an engineering management position, though growth opportunities exist over time.

### Nice-to

- Have Experience

If you have experience building and optimizing real-time speech processing systems (latency, streaming, stability), working with modern STT engines and their evaluation, or modern TTS engines and voice pipeline integration, that's valuable. Experience designing, developing, and optimizing IVR applications or working with CPaa. S platforms like Twilio for telephony workflows and conversational routing is a plus. We'd also appreciate experience architecting ML/LLM evaluation pipelines and quality systems (offline + online evaluation, golden sets, regression testing), or work with recommendation systems, automation systems, or large-scale workflow orchestration.

Familiarity with Fast. API, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and Postgre. SQL is helpful, as is experience with CI/CD pipelines and production observability tooling. Any background building healthcare software and/or data processing pipelines is a bonus.

### What We Offer

We provide competitive salaries and potential equity compensation for outstanding performance. You'll work in a remote/hybrid environment with flexible PTO. Benefits include company-paid disability and life insurance, family and medical leave, medical, dental, and vision insurance, discounted pet insurance, FSA/DCA and commuter benefits, and 401k. We offer complimentary subscriptions to digital fitness classes and wellness content, plus access to our recovery suite at HQ with a cold plunge, sauna, and shower. Company-wide sponsored lunches are also part of the package.
